sentences.en: I was determined to fulfill my duties at any cost.
sentences.zh: 我决心不惜一切代价履行我的职责。

sentences.en: The desire he has had for years has been fulfilled.
sentences.zh: 他多年来渴望的愿望实现了。

sentences.en: He couldn't fulfill the promise he made to his father.
sentences.zh: 他无法兑现对父亲许下的诺言。

senses.zh: 履行；满足；实现；使结束（等于fulfil）
